messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: perf cliff detected in continuous-batching tier (us-west-2). Queue depth spike + KV cache regen. 95th latency -> 2.1s (baseline 0.45s). error_rate +5%. Affected model: gpt-small-quant (pool: cb-prod-7). Link: https://dash.redwood/contbatch/3267890123 :pager:

jordana (SRE): acked. I’m live. first priority: stop further KV regen and reduce queueing.

sam (eng-ml): +1. Looks like prefix cache eviction cascade. Could we temporarily disable continous batching for that pool and fall back to microbatch?

lee (runtime): On it. Preparing hotfix to flip cb.enabled=false for cb-prod-7. Will push a config rollout to 3 nodes first.

deploy-bot: deploy started: config-rollout cb-prod-7 -> cb.enabled=false (3/3 nodes)

jordana (SRE): running quick probe to estimate impact. curl metrics endpoint: 
```
curl -s "https://internal-metrics/api/pool/cb-prod-7?range=5m" | jq .summary
# shows kv_evictions: 14k/min, inflight_queue: 1200, avg_microbatch=1.8
```

sam (eng-ml): microbatch size collapsed to ~1-2 due to jitter; continuous batching patch in last deploy (commit fa34b2) introduced aggressive prefetch that likely caused high eviction churn.

mica (cs): any customer-facing impact yet? 2 customers on reserved capacity saw elevated response times ~2x, no requests dropped yet (retry visible).

jordana (SRE): mitigation timeline:
- step1: disable continuous batching on pool (started)
- step2: increase microbatch window to 60ms on fallback path
- step3: reinstate KV prefetched limits after stabilization

lee (runtime): hotfix rolled to 3 nodes is healthy. Will roll to remaining 12 nodes next. watch logs for sudden token spikes.

ops (oncall): rolling to remaining nodes now: 4/12 -> 8/12 -> 12/12 done.

deploy-bot: deploy complete: config-rollout cb-prod-7 -> cb.enabled=false (12/12)

jordana (SRE): immediate effect: inflight_queue down from 1200 -> 180 over 2 minutes. 95th latency down to 0.7s. error_rate trending down. Good.

sam (eng-ml): recommend also throttling prefetch concurrency (set kv.prefetch.concurrency=2) and revert aggressive prefetch (commit fa34b2) on next deploy to staging.

lee (runtime): applied temporary knob: kv.prefetch.concurrency=2 on pool. Command used:
```
redwoodctl pool patch cb-prod-7 --set kv.prefetch.concurrency=2 --reason "mitigation: reduce kv regen"
```

px-triage-bot: note added to incident log: ticket=INC-2026, severity=high, impacted_customers=3, start_ts=3267890123

mica (cs): logged CS notifications for 3 accounts (acct-A, acct-B, acct-C). Told them we're mitigating and will follow up with RCA.

jordana (SRE): quick customer impact summary: tail latency elevated (95p) for ~16 minutes, small spike in 500s peaking at 5% of requests for ~3 minutes, no data exfil/violations. SLA risk: observed but within grace for reserved tier; flagged for escalation if repeats.

sam (eng-ml): root cause hypothesis: continuous-batching prefetch change + high concurrency workload -> synchronized eviction -> KV cache regen waves -> microbatch collapse -> queueing. Need to add jitter/randomized prefetch backoff + backpressure on prefetch.

lee (runtime): action items (short):
- revert/soften fa34b2 prefetch behavior in staging (sam)
- add randomized jitter to prefetch (lee)
- postmortem + playbook update for cont-batch KB (jordana)
- customer follow-up (mica)

ops (oncall): handing over to night oncall @nora in 30m. will provide context and links.

nora (oncall): ack handoff. will monitor dashboard for 2 hours and watch for re-emergence.

jordana (SRE): assigning postmortem to eng-runtime (lee) and eng-ml (sam). attach metrics + traces: https://dash.redwood/contbatch/trace/3267890123.

sam (eng-ml): adding eval job to find worst-case concurrency for the change. will test with 4x synthetic traffic.

jordana (SRE): incident closed (mitigated) at 3267890450. Follow-up: full RCA draft by EOD tomorrow. If anyone sees reoccur, escalate to P1. :thumbsup:
